name: Suwa Mikotsuru Shuzojo
about: Suwa Mikotsuru Shuzojo makes Mikotsuru in Shimosuwa, on the shore of Lake Suwa in Nagano, near Suwa Taisha shrine. The brewery dates from the early Taisho era, and the name recalls a crane said to have appeared over the lake.

Production stopped in 2017. In 2018 Ban-ei Unso, a transport company based in Iwaki, Fukushima, took it on to keep the town's only brewery alive. It ran trial brews in the old building, then rebuilt it.
In 2021, its second season in the new brewery, its Junmai Ginjo Sankeinishiki was named Champion Sake at the International Wine Challenge. The tōji is Shigehiko Takeuchi.
